parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Describes the type of functionality that {{object}} is representing.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Human-readable description of the {{object}}. e.g. a more detailed description of {{param|Type}}.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Value of {{true}} or {{false}} that reflects the functionality.

object.description: This capability provides a boolean function that is mapped to the type of function it represents. E.g. If the instance represents a door lock ({{param|Type}} is {{enum|Locked|Type}}), a {{param|Value}} of {{true}} says the door lock is locked.
